description: SLS v1.0.15 part 3: the trailing invalidation, realised_r and CLOSED_FLAT. Each mutation is a way a laddered trade could be scored wrong without an error -- the stop trailed from the wrong rung, read on close, checked after the rungs; the walk fed candles from before the fill; a flat close dropped from the outcomes, the track record or the notifier. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/m5_trailing_ladder.json

mutations.name: the stop is never touched, so a trade can only end on its TTL
mutations.old:
if candle.low <= stop if up else candle.high >= stop:
            reason = _stop_reason(stop_r, rungs)

mutations.name: the stop is read on close, as the zone rule does, not on touch
mutations.old: if candle.low <= stop if up else candle.high >= stop:
mutations.new: if candle.close <= stop if up else candle.close >= stop:

mutations.name: the stop trails onto the rung just reached instead of one behind it
mutations.old: stop_r = Decimal(0) if rungs == 1 else ladder.rung_r(rungs - 1)

mutations.name: the TTL is never read, so a live trade can outlast its window
mutations.new: if False and candles and elapsed_candles >= ttl_candles:

mutations.name: a flat close is scored a win
observe() silently watches the pool of a laddered signal
mutations.new: if False and levels.ladder is not None:

mutations.name: the monitor never routes a laddered signal to the walk
mutations.old: if source is SignalState.ACTIVE and levels.ladder is not None:
mutations.new: if False and source is SignalState.ACTIVE and levels.ladder is not None:

mutations.name: the walk includes the entry candle, counting a high OHLC cannot order
the walk starts at publication, counting the travel down to the fill as rungs

the outcome is written without what the trade booked
a flat close drops out of `resolved`
mutations.old: return self.successes + self.failures + self.expired + self.invalidated + self.closed_flat

the notifier never closes the loop on a flat close
